sources.title: Agreement between the European Union and the Republic of Peru on the short-stay visa waiver
sources.publisher: Publications Office of the European Union
sources.officialityEvidence: EUR-Lex publishes the Agreement in the Official Journal of the European Union and identifies the Publications Office as site manager.
sources.supportingExcerpt: This Agreement provides for visa-free travel for the citizens of the Union and for the citizens of Peru.

sources.title: Council Decision (EU) 2016/437 on signing and provisional application
sources.officialityEvidence: EUR-Lex publishes this Council Decision in the Official Journal of the European Union.
sources.supportingExcerpt: The Agreement shall be applied on a provisional basis as from the day following the date of signature.

policies.title: Peruvian ordinary passports to covered EU Member States
policies.summary: Peruvian citizens holding valid ordinary passports may enter and stay without a visa in the covered Member States for short stays.
conditions: The agreement's final entry into force was 2016-11-01; it was provisionally applied from 2016-03-15.
The source covers valid ordinary, diplomatic, service, official, and special passports; this policy is deliberately limited to ordinary passports.
Paid activity is excluded; applicable Union, Member-State, and Peruvian rules continue to govern it.
Peruvian citizens may stay up to 90 days in any 180-day period in Member States fully applying the Schengen acquis; the limit is independent in each Member State not fully applying it.
France and the Netherlands are covered only in their European territories; the agreement is without prejudice to entry and short-stay conditions and refusal of entry.
Ireland and the United Kingdom are excluded from the agreement; the latter is outside this packet's codes.

policies.title: Covered EU ordinary passports to Peru
policies.summary: Citizens of the covered EU Member States holding valid ordinary passports may enter and stay without a visa in Peru for short stays.
conditions: The agreement's final entry into force was 2016-11-01; it was provisionally applied from 2016-03-15.
The source covers valid ordinary, diplomatic, service, official, and special passports; this policy is deliberately limited to ordinary passports.
Paid activity is excluded; applicable Union, Member-State, and Peruvian rules continue to govern it.
Citizens of the Union may stay in Peru for a maximum of 90 days in any 180-day period.
The agreement is without prejudice to entry and short-stay conditions and Peru may refuse entry or short stay where those conditions are unmet.
Ireland and the United Kingdom are excluded from the agreement; the latter is outside this packet's codes.

unresolved.reason: Not established: the agreement expressly does not apply to Ireland, and no separate Irish rule was researched in this agreement-only batch.
